title: VOID license ledger
description: Schema for docs/content-rights/ledger.json. Enforced machine-side by void_content::LicenseLedger::parse + check_against (tests/content).

id.description: Ledger id; inventory rights.agreement_ref points here.

license_id.description: Licence identifier carried on the inventory entry (e.g. LIC-ORCH-SAMPLES-01).

grant.description: Human summary of granted rights (bundling, redistribution scope).

status.description: required = identified need, no agreement; executed = agreement_sha256 must be set; revoked = entry must not ship.

agreement_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the executed agreement artifact; required when status is executed.
